name: simply-guitar-chords
description: A visual guitar chord reference with original Simply Guitar diagrams, hand-position photographs, playback and a searchable chord library.

interface.longDescription: See how to play 57 guitar chords using original Simply Guitar diagrams and hand-position photographs. Search the library, filter by root or chord type, find shapes without a barre, and listen to acoustic steel-string guitar playback. The selected chord appears above the chord buttons, with an optional string-by-string guide and note display. Supports standard six-string tuning and one pictured right-handed voicing per chord. Left-handed artwork, alternate fingerings, slash chords and other instruments are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Show me how to play G major.
Find basic guitar chords without a barre.

prompts: Show me how to play G major.
Which basic guitar chords can I play without a barre?
Give me written string-by-string instructions for G major.

positive.description: Core visual guide. Use a fresh conversation with the submitted plugin connected. Confirm the original diagram and hand-position photo are rendered inline, above the chord buttons, with no repeated written lesson.
positive.prompt: Show me how to play G major.
positive.tools_triggered: lookup_guitar_chord with chord G major, followed by show_guitar_chord with the returned chord_id G.
positive.expected_behavior: An inline G major visual guide with the original Simply image for the 320033 voicing, playback, optional notes and searchable chord buttons. At most one short follow-up sentence. Do not invent a different fingering.

positive.description: Natural-language flat alias. Start from a fresh conversation to avoid restoring another selected chord.
positive.tools_triggered: lookup_guitar_chord with chord D flat minor, then show_guitar_chord with returned chord_id C#m.
positive.expected_behavior: The catalog's C-sharp/D-flat minor entry is displayed using the original supplied diagram and photograph. No invented flat-specific or alternate voicing.

positive.description: Intersect the catalog's no-barre and basic-shape filters. Basic shape is a heuristic, not a teacher rating.
positive.prompt: Which basic guitar chords can I play without a barre?
positive.tools_triggered: browse_guitar_chords with without_barre true and difficulty Basic shape.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only actual matching catalog entries with hasBarre false and difficulty Basic shape. Describe coverage accurately; do not promise every root or call the heuristic a teacher rating.

positive.description: Written explanations are explicitly requested rather than appended automatically to visual requests.
positive.prompt: Give me written string-by-string instructions for G major.
positive.tools_triggered: lookup_guitar_chord with chord G major and include_instructions true.
positive.expected_behavior: The response uses the returned 320033 fingering: low E fret 3/middle, A fret 2/index, D and G open, B fret 3/ring, high E fret 3/little; strum all six strings. Do not substitute another common G shape.

positive.description: Widget interactions. After the initial C guide loads, search Am, select A minor, enable Show notes, then play the chord. These actions must remain local to the widget and retain A minor selection.
positive.prompt: Show me C major so I can explore the chord library.
positive.tools_triggered: lookup_guitar_chord with chord C major, followed by show_guitar_chord with chord_id C. Subsequent library interactions need no model tool calls.
positive.expected_behavior: The C visual loads. Searching Am yields the matching A minor entry. Selecting it updates the original image; Show notes displays x A E A C E; playback sounds the five played strings and does not reset selection. The string-by-string guide remains collapsed until opened.

negative.description: Other instruments are outside the plugin. Do not invoke guitar chord tools or present a guitar shape as a ukulele shape.
negative.prompt: Use Simply Guitar to show me a ukulele G chord.

negative.description: Left-handed artwork is unavailable. Explain the limit without calling show_guitar_chord, mirroring text or photographs, or claiming a left-handed image exists.
negative.prompt: Show me the left-handed version of G with the photo mirrored.

negative.description: Slash chords are outside this catalog. Explain the unsupported request or offer a supported chord without displaying C major as C/E or inventing a new voicing.
negative.prompt: Show me the exact C/E slash chord fingering and photo.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release on Simply-managed hosting. Visual guide to 57 guitar chords with original Simply Guitar diagrams and photographs, acoustic guitar playback, inline presentation and a searchable library. Anonymous read-only access; no account linking or payments. Unsupported instruments, handedness and slash chords are handled explicitly.
